answer_1.quote: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) combines retrieval systems and generative models to produce responses without requiring extensive retraining.
answer_1.outputs: responses to answerable and unanswerable queries in a RAG system

answer_2.quote: We propose three metrics to evaluate the capability of RAG systems to reject unanswerable requests.

answer_3.quote: Subsequently, following Section 3.3, three LLMs - GPT-4o, Claude 3.5 Sonnet and Deepseek-R1 ... are prompted to assign labels to the request-response pairs.

answer_4.quote: Three authors independently label 150 request-response pairs as answered / unanswered / ask for clarification and acceptable / unacceptable.
answer_4.guideline: The authors' labels are based on predefined criteria for each unanswerable category, including definitions and examples provided in the paper.
